crawlers.maintain.verifyMethod.evidence: LIVE TEST 2026-05-13T08:41Z: probed 15 known-in-stock newest products via Store API ?include= -- ALL 15 returned (no false negatives in the in-stock half). Then probed 20 older products (IDs from WP REST page 100) -- 14 of 20 (70%) MISSING from Store API ?include but present with status=publish in WP REST admin. Confirmed: missing products are out-of-stock (Store API ?stock_status=outofstock returns them) but their detail pages render HTTP 200 with valid price (e.g. /product/just-right-carbines-glock-m-lok-model-burnt-bronze-9mm-luger-18-6-threaded-barrel/ = $1399.99 'Out of stock'). Out-of-stock = LIVE PRODUCT, not deleted. Site-wide split: 2299 in-stock + 2931 out-of-stock = 5230 total. Runtime worker.ts:537-546 is already SAFE (skips missing-from-store-api instead of deactivating since 2026-04-03 fix), so store-api would not re-trigger the 2,898-product incident -- BUT it does NOT save cost vs detail-page: store-api fast-path handles only 2299 in-stock products (44%), then falls through to Playwright for 2931 out-of-stock (56%). detail-page sends all 5230 through Playwright. Cost ratio store-api:detail-page = roughly 56% of full Playwright + 44% of fast-batch -- modest savings ONLY if our DB has the right mix. DB's documented decision (post-incident 2026-04-03: 'Switched to detail-page verification') is the safer default; preserves operator history. Recommend detail-page.
